schema.frames: frames.<key>: key = the frame file's name without .png (the qa_key)
schema.state: one of not_yet | almost | final_test | approved_for_site (docs/ops/quality-gate-g-ed-2026-11-07.md §3); master-designer's eye verdicts are folded in: a pending eye verdict keeps a frame at 'almost' at most, a failed one makes it 'not_yet'
schema.rows: frames.<key>.rows: one row per product (and per option when the frame shows two options of one card). card_id = the card's id; option = an object of the card's option value ids (from data/story/story.json or the card's axes), a label as text when no id matched, or null for the card's default; verdict = yes | partly | no ('partly' is 'partial'); note = why; dot = yes | no | closeup_only (G-ED.5 and recipe §6: a dot only on 'yes', or on 'partly' through a faithful close-up)
schema.compat: every row also carries the fields site/tools/lib/qa-frames.ts reads today: card (card_id plus the label), present, faithful (= verdict), why (= note)
schema.fixed_furniture: frames.<key>.fixed_furniture: the board furniture without a card (no dot); kept out of rows
schema.superseded_by: older frame keys that the site may still name, mapped to the frame that replaces them
schema.pending_qa: frames that landed after this version and are not checked yet
schema.closeups: closeups.<qa_key>: layer 2's close-ups, keyed by their qa_key, in the same shape as frames.<key> (file, state of the four, rows with card_id, option, verdict, note, dot); site/tools/lib/qa-frames.ts reads frames.<key> ?? closeups.<key>
schema.units_in_frame: optional on a row: what the look puts in the cart for this product and option when the frame shows more than one physical unit, counted in purchasable units: a set SKU or a site pack counts once (sale_unit says which, units_note what the frame shows). 1-12, read by site/tools/lib/qa-frames.ts
schema.tool: tool.<room/style/phase>: G1/G2 results of tool assets, kept apart from the editorial frames; the site does not read it
schema.designs_in_frame: optional: a card shown in several different options (e.g. prints of one listing); those need one row per option, not units
schema.master: master.<qa_key>: the master bedroom's story frames (G-ED), the same shape as frames; kept apart until the room's story goes to the site

versioning: a new dated file per QA round, never an edit: qa/reports/ged-register-<date>.json, and qa/reports/ged-register-<date>-r<N>.json for a second round the same day; each has version (+1) and supersedes (the previous file). The site reads the file with the highest version
